title: Email Domain / SMTP (Atlas Engine)
content:
Outbound email

  • Configure via repo-root SMTP_* env vars, then run engine/fixtures/configure_smtp.py as user frappe. This upserts Email Account EswasaOne Outbound (default outgoing).
  • Same SMTP_* vars feed Core OTP / confirmation mail (core/app/adapters/messaging.py).
  • Until SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM are set, OTP and invites stay stubbed / 503 (no accidental outbound mail).
  • Desk: Email Account → Send Test after configure.
